items.name: covenant-engine-editor
items.title: Covenant engine editor
items.description: Edits a covenant engine with the generated form, optionally starting from a Rust covenant package template, and lists each covenant's metric id against the model's nodes.
items.docs: Composes schema-form over the generated covenant_engine contract (started from defaultJson; Rust publishes no example, so it otherwise starts empty). When loadTemplate is supplied, a template bar loads the specs of a Rust package (covenants.covLite, lboStandard, realEstate or projectFinance) for thresholds typed into decimal inputs that start empty; a blank threshold is sent as NaN and a rejected template shows the native error. Every metric_id and denominator_metric_id (top-level and windowed specs) is an id-combobox: free text with metricIds as suggestions. A Covenant metrics table lists each spec's metric id and whether metricIds contains it, before any evaluation; an unset metric id is listed as read by Rust's conventional metric for the covenant type and is not checked. Validation, templates and every term are native: connect validate to useCovenantEngineValidator, loadTemplate to useCovenantTemplate and onSubmit to the useEvaluateCovenants request. Accepts defaultJson, validate, onSubmit, loadTemplate, metricIds, disabled and density props.

items.name: covenant-breach-forecast
items.title: Covenant breach forecast
items.description: Forecasts covenant breaches under a CovenantForecastConfig edited with the generated form and presents the returned FutureBreach rows.
items.docs: Composes schema-form over the generated covenant_forecast_config contract (started from defaultConfigJson; Rust publishes no example and an empty config takes Rust's deterministic maintenance-scope defaults; Rust validates the config when it forecasts, so the form checks structure only and a uint64 random_seed stays exact) and a finstack-table of native FutureBreach rows (statements_analytics.forecastBreaches) in the order supplied, which Rust sorts by breach date, then covenant id: date, covenant, Rust's test description, projected value, threshold, headroom and breach probability with every supplied digit (a host may inject formatValue), an unset value as a dash. Deterministic forecasts list breached dates with probability 1; a stochastic config also lists dates whose probability reaches its breach_probability_threshold. Connect onSubmit to the useForecastBreaches request. Accepts defaultConfigJson, onSubmit, breaches, loading, error, formatValue and density props. No worker is required.

items.name: covenant-compliance
items.title: Covenant compliance
items.description: Displays a native covenant series as a covenant by test-date grid of returned verdicts; selecting a date shows its covenant reports.
items.docs: Present native DatedCovenantReports rows (statements_analytics.evaluateCovenants over statement results, or CovenantEngine#evaluateSeries over dated rows) as a grid: one column per test date in the order supplied, one row per covenant instance key in first-appearance order, each cell the returned verdict as Passed or Failed, or a dash when Rust returned no report for that covenant on that date. A date header button selects the date (the latest initially) and its reports render below through covenant-report. Nothing is computed, sorted or inferred. No worker is required.

items.name: covenant-report
items.title: Covenant report
items.description: Displays native covenant reports: test, actual, threshold, headroom, verdict and details per covenant, with the complete JSON.
items.docs: Present native CovenantReport values keyed by covenant instance key (CovenantEngine#evaluate, one DatedCovenantReports row, or a valuation result's covenants) as a typed table in the order supplied: Rust's test description, actual value, threshold and headroom with every supplied digit (a host may inject formatValue), the passed verdict as Passed or Failed, and details; a field Rust leaves unset shows as a dash. The complete reports stay available as JSON in a Covenants disclosure. No verdict, headroom or threshold is computed. No worker is required.

items.name: use-covenant-engine-validator
items.title: useCovenantEngineValidator
items.description: Validates covenant engine JSON natively and returns its canonical text through the WASM worker.
items.docs: covenants.validateCovenantEngineJson: canonical CovenantEngine text (schema, covenant package and engine invariants, unknown fields), or the native error. Pass it as schema-form's or covenant-engine-editor's validate. Requires the shared Finstack provider.

items.name: use-covenant-template
items.title: useCovenantTemplate
items.description: Loads a Rust covenant package template through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Returns a loader: {kind: "covLite", maxLeverage, maxSeniorLeverage} calls covenants.covLite, {kind: "lboStandard", initialLeverage, interestCoverage, fixedChargeCoverage, maxCapex} lboStandard, {kind: "realEstate", minDscr, minDebtYield, maxLtv} realEstate and {kind: "projectFinance", minDscr, distributionLockupDscr, minLiquidity, maxNetLeverage} projectFinance; it resolves to the returned CovenantSpec objects or rejects with the native error (a NaN, infinite or negative threshold). Pass it as covenant-engine-editor's loadTemplate. Requires the shared Finstack provider.

items.name: use-evaluate-covenants
items.title: useEvaluateCovenants
items.description: Tests a covenant engine against evaluated statements through the WASM worker.
items.docs: covenants.CovenantEngine.fromJson(engineJson), then statements_analytics.evaluateCovenants(resultsJson, engine, modelJson): DatedCovenantReports rows, one per result period tested on its last day with the covenants applicable on that date. The handle is freed. A metric an applicable covenant reads that the results lack returns the native not_found error, a non-finite one the validation error, unchanged. Keyed on the complete request and worker session; null disables. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-forecast-breaches
items.title: useForecastBreaches
items.description: Forecasts covenant breaches of evaluated statements through the WASM worker.
items.docs: covenants.CovenantEngine.fromJson(engineJson), then statements_analytics.forecastBreaches(resultsJson, engine, modelJson, configJson?): FutureBreach rows sorted by breach date, then covenant id. Every result period is a test date and, without reference_date, the horizon starts the day before the first period. An omitted configJson is Rust's deterministic maintenance-scope default; the config crosses as JSON text so a uint64 random_seed stays exact. The handle is freed. A missing required metric returns the native not_found error, a non-finite one or an invalid config the validation error, unchanged. Keyed on the complete request and worker session; null disables. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.
